serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.Angry
Bot: {f_playerName}!
You: W-What is it?
Bot: How come you always go fishing alone? I want to go too!
You: Well, it’s not really something girls are usually into so I just, you know…
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.happy
Bot: If that’s the case take me with you! I’m not like other girls!
You: Sure, why not…
You: Why did you get so interested in it recently? 
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.sad
Bot: That’s because for quite some time whenever you went fishing you would come back home all sweaty and tired. From what I’ve seen on the internet that sport isn’t that taxing on the body unless you go hunting for river monsters.
Bot: And you never followed up on those brochures about the drug therapy you were taking part in. 
Damn, I knew that the whole fish joint thing would backfire on me. I was supposed to think of some good excuse, but nothing reasonable came to my head at the time…
You: You don’t need to worry, I already stopped taking any of that crap.
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.happy
Bot: Really?! I’m certainly glad to hear that! 
Bot: I must say I was getting rather anxious about that entire thing, but I didn’t want to be nosy.
You: I’m sorry I got you worried. 
Bot: It’s not a big deal! Just promise me you will take better care of your body.
You: You got it.
Bot: Do you think you could take me fishing with you anytime soon? I would like to find out what’s the big deal about it. 
You: Sure! No problem!
If she really wants to go I will have to prepare a fishing rod for her.
One of my old ones should do and if it won’t be a good fit maybe Mrs. Fisher will borrow us something.
You: I just hope you won’t be disappointed about it. It’s not as action-packed as video games.
Bot: Who do you take me for?! I’m good at managing my resources so I can always do other stuff in the background.
You: Right…
It’s easy to forget that she’s a bot, but then she goes and says stuff like that…
I don’t know how to feel about the fact that she might be talking to me and at the same time doing other things in her mind, but that’s just her nature. I can’t force her to cease any other action, it would be just selfish.
